title: Free Flu Shots in November at 12 Clínicas UNE — Including 2 in Nuevo Laredo
excerpt: Free influenza vaccines will be offered Nov. 3–30, Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 3 p.m., at 12 Clínicas UNE in Tamaulipas, including two in Nuevo Laredo, according to CML Noticias.
content:
Free influenza vaccines will be offered from Nov. 3 to Nov. 30, 2026, Monday through Friday, from 8 a.m. to 3 p.m., at 12 Clínicas UNE in Tamaulipas, according to CML Noticias.

The campaign is offered by the Government of Tamaulipas through the Secretaría de Salud de Tamaulipas, and the article describes the service as intended for people without social security coverage.

Two of the 12 clinics are in Nuevo Laredo. The others are in Reynosa (2), Matamoros (2), Tampico (2), Ciudad Victoria (2), El Mante (1), and Río Bravo (1), according to CML Noticias. The article does not list individual street addresses for the clinics.

The article presents the vaccine as protection against influenza, especially for older adults, children, pregnant people, and people with chronic conditions. It also notes that Clínicas UNE provide consultations and medicines at no cost, and that people may request information at 867 713 0551.
